<!-- Before reporting: check that the bug is not already reported and that you are on the latest version. -->

## Describe the bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

## Expected behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior
What actually happened (include error messages / stack traces).

## Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

## Environment
- Panelku version: [e.g. 2.0.0]
- Node.js version: [e.g. 20.x / 24.x]
- OS / distro: [e.g. Ubuntu 24.04]
- Browser (if frontend issue): [e.g. Chrome 126]
- Deployment: [bare metal / Docker / agent-node]

## Regression test
- [ ] I will provide / the maintainers may add a regression test for this bug (Test-First policy).

## Additional context
Add any other context about the problem here (logs, config snippets — redact secrets!).
